# Patterns for common spark-shared class files that must not be promoted to
# the root layout even when binary dedupe marks them bitwise-identical.
#
# Add entries only when a class must remain in the parallel-world layout
# for compatibility, packaging, or follow-up validation reasons. New common
# classes should normally stay unshimmed by default.

# These rule containers are loaded through ShimLoader and instantiate
# shim-sensitive GpuOverrides.class. Keep the containers in the parallel-world
# layout so the shim classloader resolves GpuOverrides from the selected shim.
com/nvidia/spark/rapids/ColumnarOverrideRules*.class
com/nvidia/spark/rapids/GpuQueryStagePrepOverrides*.class
